'''"EveryMediaWiki"''' is a project to bring back WikiApiary as a Wikibase.

== Purposes ==

* Proof of concept of Wikibase federation: Librarybase using not just Wikidata but also Miraheze Communities, and Wikibase World as remote sources
* Tracking InternetArchiveBot deployments
* Tracking MediaWiki extension usage
* The other useful things WikiApiary did

== Goals ==

* Repurpose the WikiApiary crawlers to write to Librarybase instead
* Develop a new frontend for exploring the MediaWiki instances tracked in Librarybase
* Acquire the WikiApiary domain name and repurpose it for the new frontend
